Actual product is 'Dr. Really Extra', an unregistered copycat of the registered Yef Real Extra (A11-0298). 190 cartons destroyed by NAFDAC, Mar 2019. Lab tested at University of Lagos: passed assay but 'regulatory details are not satisfactory'; no maker address, not registered, not dated.
